text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What an epicurean feast! I doff my cap to whoever cooked up this mille-feuille.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed… The hints of brandy in the crust gave it a real depth. It paired very nicely with my coffee.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No… I merely noticed that your expression has softened.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: When Teio told me about the new items on the menu here, I thought of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad it is to your taste. I trust some of your fatigue has lifted?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …It appears that I've caused you some concern.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you were able to discern my fatigue so easily, then I still have much to learn. I'll see to it that this doesn't happen again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I don't know what I would do if something were to happen to you. Please don't try to hide these things from me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I appreciate the concern, but…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Shall we go for a short stroll, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Though the sun sinks low in the sky, its warmth is still strong in the evening air.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Um, President—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You are quite like the sun, you know. A blazing symbol shining bright for all Umamusume to see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If I may continue the metaphor, I wish to be like the earth. The verdant soil of happiness upon which their dreams may sprout.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: These new dreams witness hope in the light of the sun—and as they reach toward it, they grow their stalks and finally flower.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With you as the sun and me as the earth, we shall achieve our dreams and create a paradise for all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We are two unique individuals with differing strengths. Don't look down on yourself just because I possess something you do not.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Thank you. I'll keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The presidents ambitions are great, and her outlook is vast. She always stands out as a shining example to aspire to.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Whenever she encourages me, I start to rely on her, and I find myself wanting to agree with everything she says…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But… I have to do better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove quietly tells me about the previous day's events. As she finishes, a fierce determination starts to burn in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I… do want to be like the sun. But on one condition…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I want to be a sun that captivates even the great earth and makes it yearn to reach into the sky!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't very well call myself the Empress if I'm only chasing after the Emperor's coattails!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's get to work, Trainer! There are heights I have yet to reach!
choice_data_list: We'll dazzle them all with your signature move!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: My signature move? Heh…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No matter who tries to block my path, I'll come out victorious in the end!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't take your eyes off me—not even for a second.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The Empress will dazzle everyone with her famous last-minute burst of speed!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Uh…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: O-oh, right, I see now… Because I'm the sun. Right.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh… You really lost me there for a second, haha!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the laugh. I feel a lot less tense now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's get back to business. Today is another step forward in pursuit of my ideals.
